rationale: SEDG has experienced an extreme intraday range ($29.91–$37.54) with 4.58x relative volume, suggesting a large catalyst-driven dislocation. Price is now sitting in the middle of that range (43.5%) with session VWAP ($35.84) far overhead creating substantial resistance, while the recent 5-candle sequence shows a shallow bounce from ~$32.88 with diminishing volume and no clear directional conviction.
